It examines numerous local examples, including the San Gabriel Mission, Castle Green, the Caltech campus, the Civic Center, the 1920s Spanish Colonial Revival houses built by George Washington Smith, Wallace Neff, and many others, along with more recent Hispanic inflected projects such as the Del Mar Station.\nDave Nufer has previously given talks at the Pasadena Public Library on the architecture, history, and cultural contributions of other Pasadena ethnic communities. Williams helped to develop, in Pasadena and elsewhere, the style we now refer to as “Spanish Colonial Revival”. Their houses combined red tile roofs, white, stucco, walls, arcades, decorative iron work, and colorful polychromatic tiles in houses that created lush, Mediterranean, paradises, and that have defined Pasadena and Southern California  for the world visually, then and to this day.”\\n\\n\\n - Dave Nufer, presenter and member of the Pasadena Heritage Board of Directors and Education Committee\\n\\n\\nEVENT HISTORY/ BACKGROUND:\\n\\nHispanic Architectural Influence in Shaping Pasadena’s Cityscape\\n\\n\\n \\nThe early 20th Century saw the birth of the Spanish Colonial Revival style in Southern California. Presenter and Board Member Dave Nufer will examine the many notable Spanish Colonial Revival style buildings in Pasadena including City Hall, the Central Library, the Pasadena Playhouse, and the historic Caltech campus. A study of Pasadena’s recent Hispanic-influenced projects, such as the Del Mar Station complex and the Paseo, will be included as well. Join us as we trace the thousand-year development of Spanish architecture from its Moorish roots to its revival and prominence in Pasadena today. \\n \\n\\nPrevious Pasadena Now story:\\n\\nThe Pasadena Public Library hosts Dave Nufer, program developer and docent with Pasadena Heritage and the Los Angeles Conservancy, in a virtual webinar from 4 to 5 p.m. Wednesday, where he explains how Spanish-influenced architecture has become one of the greatest Latinx contributions to American culture.\\nNufer will also present how Hispanic architecture — with millions of examples from California to Florida built by tens of millions of people over the last 400 years  —  has helped shape Pasadena’s cityscape.\\nThe presentation focuses on how the Spanish/Hispanic/Latinx architectural design vocabulary evolved over 1,000 years on four continents, and how it has been employed in Pasadena. It examines numerous local examples, including the San Gabriel Mission, Castle Green, the Caltech campus, the Civic Center, the 1920s Spanish Colonial Revival houses built by George Washington Smith, Wallace Neff, and many others, along with more recent Hispanic inflected projects such as the Del Mar Station.\\nDave Nufer has previously given talks at the Pasadena Public Library on the architecture, history, and cultural contributions of other Pasadena ethnic communities. It examines numerous local examples, including the San Gabriel Mission, Castle Green, the Caltech campus, the Civic Center, the 1920s Spanish Colonial Revival houses built by George Washington Smith, Wallace Neff, and many others, along with more recent Hispanic inflected projects such as the Del Mar Station.\nDave Nufer has previously given talks at the Pasadena Public Library on the architecture, history, and cultural contributions of other Pasadena ethnic communities. (AP)** — The profound impact of Hispanic architecture on Pasadena's cityscape was the focus of a well-attended event Thursday, Sept. 28, as part of the city's Hispanic Heritage Month celebrations. Renowned presenter Dave Nufer guided attendees through a historical journey, highlighting the birth and evolution of the Spanish Colonial Revival style in the early 20th century.\n\nIconic landmarks such as City Hall, the Central Library, and Caltech's historic campus were showcased, along with contemporary Hispanic-influenced projects like the Del Mar Station complex and the Paseo. "Generator在设计评分标准时，若遇到'only N'的长度约束，不应直接使用模糊的'不超过'或'等于'，而应结合上下文判断：若上下文暗示是最大容量（如'limit', 'max'），则设为'不超过'；若上下文强调精确规格（如'exact length', 'precise count'），则设为'精确等于'。若上下文不明，应在标准中明确写出'精确等于N'或'不超过N'，并保留注释说明选择依据，防止因术语歧义导致评分失效。", "retrieval_source": "semantic", "historical_reward": null, "evidence_tasks": 0}, {"experience_id": "8", "trigger": "Generator在设计Rubric时，若任务明确要求生成多个实体（使用复数形式如'words',
